Hi Sara / Blue Harbor team,

Thanks for starting onboarding with Redwood — we’re excited to get Blue Harbor Analytics set up. For Accounts Payable to issue a PO we need the following items on file: 

- Completed and signed W-8BEN-E (we require a PDF with signatures)
- Notarized Certificate of Foreign Status / Attestation for the entity (not a simple electronic signature; a stamped notary on the attestation is required per our internal tax policy)
- A sample invoice showing billing address and tax ID (to match against the W-8BEN-E)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached) with bank/ACH instructions if you will accept ACH

I’ve attached the Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.docx for you to complete. If you can return the W-8BEN-E and sample invoice this week that would be great — the PO creation is on a tight timeline for an initial pilot. Note that we will hold the PO pending receipt of the notarized certificate; we can create a conditional PO for testing if needed.

Logistics/notes:
- Please ensure the entity name on the W-8BEN-E exactly matches their legal name on invoices and the notary packet.
- If Blue Harbor is a branch of a larger group, please attach a beneficial owner attestation listing the ultimate parent.
- If you prefer, send scanned PDFs in one email with filenames indicating content.

Thanks — I’m copying Priyom from Procurement and Marcus from Finance so we can triage the PO once docs arrive.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Ops, Redwood Inference
